group.name: App UI <-> API Server
group.modules: App.js + DashboardScreen (UI)  <->  api.js (fetchPosts/fetchUser)  <->  API server (jsonplaceholder, stubbed)
group.strategy: Top-Down Integration: the top-level App/Dashboard UI is integrated with the real API module; the remote server is replaced by a stub returning jsonplaceholder-shaped data.
group.dataPassed: UI -> API: userId, limit (GET /posts?userId=1, GET /users/1);  API -> UI: JSON posts[] / user{} parsed into models, or error message
